title: Child Education Planning
shortText: Plan for the rising cost of your child's education.
whatItIs: Education costs in India have been rising faster than general inflation. Planning early lets you invest smaller amounts over a longer period. You estimate the future cost of the course, then invest regularly towards it, moving to lower-risk schemes as the goal date approaches.
whoItSuits: Parents and grandparents who want to build a fund for a child's higher education, typically 5 to 18 years away.
howItWorks: Estimate today's cost of the course and the years remaining
Use the goal calculator to see the future cost and the SIP needed
Start a SIP and link the folios to an Education goal
Shift gradually to debt-oriented schemes in the last two to three years

faqs.question: Can I invest in my child's name?
faqs.answer: Yes, investments can be made in a minor's name with a parent or guardian, subject to KYC of the guardian.

faqs.question: What if the goal date is close?
faqs.answer: For goals less than three years away, lower-volatility schemes are usually considered.
